surface_mechanism_description: Possible alternating surface reactions, as inspired by previous studies of using a similar metal amidinate precursor, are the following: Ni(dad)2 dissociatively reacts with the surface and affords Ni3C with some hydrocarbon surface moieties, and then the hydrocarbon moieties are hydrogenated by H2 plasma and liberated from the surface.
